The Bosch Research and Technology Center North America with offices in Sunnyvale, California, Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, and Cambridge, Massachusetts is a part of the global Bosch Group (www.bosch.com), a company with over 70 billion euro revenue, 400,000 employees worldwide, a very diverse product portfolio, and a history spanning over 125 years. The Research and Technology Center North America (RTC-NA) is dedicated to providing technologies and system solutions for various Bosch business fields, primarily in the field of artificial intelligence, energy technologies, internet technologies, circuit design, semiconductors and wireless, as well as advanced MEMS design.

Provide technical support to the Bosch water electrolysis research team for electrolysis cell testing and characterization. The intern responsibility includes assembling test rigs, operating/monitoring electrolysis test benches, processing and interpretating testing results, and carrying out physical analysis. Additional responsibilities may include further development of testing methodology and/or further development of lab scale test capability.

Required Qualifications
Obtained or currently pursuing MS or PhD in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Material Sciences or related technical fields.
Minimum GPA of 3.0
Hands on experience with PEM water electrolysis testing hardware and equipment. This ideally includes subscale or short-stack testing.
Experience with electrochemical testing equipment.
Familiar with data processing and interpretation.
Be enthusiastic and able to collaborate in a team environment.
Curious and passionate about learning and exploring.
Ability to translate technical concepts into simple to understand, communicable ideas.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with advanced characterization techniques, e.g., SEM, XRF, XRD, gas MS, etc.
Experience with script coding, data analysis automation and interpretation.
Publications to demonstrate past work in the hydrogen energy conversion field.

The U.S. base salary range for this intern position is $41.00/hr - $55.00/hr. Within the range, individual pay is determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, type of degree, work experience and job knowledge, complexity of the role, type of position, job location, etc. Your Hiring Manager can share more details about the specific salary range for this position during the interview process.*

title: Team Lead Cloud Engineering (m/f/x)
jd:
#### **Who we are**

At Reverion, we’re on a mission to enable a decentralized, flexible, and carbon\-negative energy system. And that’s what drives us every day.  

  

We are developing innovative, reversible power plants that can efficiently convert gases such as biogas or hydrogen into electricity and heat. When needed, the process can be reversed to transform renewable energy into storable green gases. With an efficiency of up to 80%, Reverion power plants are among the most efficient in the world.  

  

Sounds interesting? Then apply now for the role of **Team Lead Cloud Engineering (m/f/x)** and become part of our team!

#### **Your mission**

As Team Lead Cloud Engineering (m/f/x), you are the driving force at the intersection of PLC systems and modern cloud infrastructure. You lead a team that connects our plants, makes real\-time data actionable, and actively drives digital solutions like our Remote Plant Operation Cockpit.

#### **1/ Fleet Management \& Operations**

* You own and shape the strategy for plant **connectivity** and secure remote access.
* You optimize deployment processes (CI/CD) for over\-the\-air (OTA) updates in the field.
* You ensure that our plants can be monitored and controlled at all times.

#### **2/ Data Infrastructure**

* You lead the design and operation of a highly available data infrastructure.
* You manage modern time\-series databases (e.g., **InfluxDB, ClickHouse**) and implement scalable streaming solutions (**MQTT, Kafka**).
* You ensure real\-time processing of sensor data in close collaboration with our Data Analytics \& Digital Solutions team.

#### **3/ Services \& Core Libraries**

* You drive the development of central services and libraries (data logging, alarming systems).
* You are responsible for monitoring IT resources and integrating the field level (e.g., via EtherCAT).
* You support our PLC developers as well as application and control engineers with software development and feature implementation where needed.

#### **4/ Leadership \& Strategy**

* You lead and mentor a team of software developers, supporting both technical and personal growth.
* You shape the long\-term vision for our software stack and translate business requirements into a clear technical roadmap.
* As the interface between operations, engineering, and data science, you prioritize requirements and translate them into a structured product backlog.

#### **Your profile**

* You hold a Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, or a related field.
* You bring several years of hands\-on experience in software development with hardware integration (ideally in the energy sector or Industrial IoT).
* You've led development teams (at least technically) and thrive in agile project management (SCRUM) as well as precise requirements engineering.
* You are skilled in **Python, C\#, or Rust** and have no fear of PLC systems (e.g., Beckhoff TwinCAT).
* You're a true generalist and act as a translator between cloud architects, DevOps engineers, and PLC programmers.
* You speak English fluently and German at a good level (minimum B1\).

#### **What we offer**

* **Strategy \& ownership**: Play a key role in shaping our projects and driving meaningful decisions forward
* **Make an impact**: Flat hierarchies, short decision paths, and real ownership give you the freedom to turn ideas into action
* **Work that keeps you growing**: Tackle diverse, exciting challenges in a dynamic and innovative environment that supports continuous growth
* **Work your way**: Flexible working hours and remote options help you work when and where you’re at your best
* **Modern setup**: High\-quality IT equipment and an ergonomic office environment ensure a productive and comfortable workday
* **Team spirit**: Mutual trust, open feedback, and an agile mindset create a supportive and inspiring workplace
* **Grow with us**: Dedicated time and budget for training and professional development support your personal and career growth
* **Experience more together**: Subsidized lunches and regular team events encourage connection and strengthen collaboration
* **Stay healthy \& active**: Wellness benefits, bike leasing, and internal sports groups support your health and well\-being
* **Sustainable mobility**: Company bikes at the S\-Bahn station and office offer flexible and eco\-friendly commuting options
* **Fair \& secure**: Performance\-based compensation, an employer contribution to retirement savings, and a monthly €50 Pluxee card provide financial stability and extra perks

#### **About us**

As spin\-off from the Technical University of Munich, we're a highly tech\-driven energy startup. Our journey began in 2018 with a groundbreaking vision: paving the way to 100% renewable energy by making the most out of biogas. Since then, the team has grown and is ready to overcome all potential market entry barriers.  

  

Reverion is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are open to all groups of people without regard to age, color, national origin, religion, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

We encourage everyone to apply and give us a chance to evaluate your skills and experience. We are all learning on the job, and although the listing above has been carefully compiled, we are also open\-minded and interested to hear about the value you can bring to the role and Reverion.

title: Student Worker - Hydrogen Team
jd:
***Come Innovate Motion with Us***

*The Student Worker will support research and development activities within the SOEC and Metal Hydride project. The role focuses on assisting with metal hydride compact development, electrochemical testing, technical documentation, and research analysis. The position contributes to experimental execution, data evaluation, and coordination activities that support ongoing public\-funded research projects. The student will work closely with engineers and researchers while gaining hands\-on experience in advanced energy and materials technologies. A strong focus on delivering high\-quality, customer\-cantered solutions is essential, while adhering to Johnson Electric’s Environmental, Health \& Safety, Quality, and Human Resources policies. Maintaining safe and efficient work practices is critical.*

***Your responsibilities will be to:***

* Support the development and fabrication of metal hydride compacts, including screening and assisting with powder metal compaction processes
* Conduct literature reviews, summarize scientific findings, and contribute to technical reports and project presentations
* Conduct and monitor SOEC measurements under defined operating conditions, including temperature, atmosphere, and current load requirements
* Develop and document test procedures and workflows covering sample preparation, mounting, measurement sequences, data acquisition, validation, shutdown, and safety procedures
* Perform systematic data collection, data cleaning, and preliminary analysis to support research activities and project objectives
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external suppliers regarding test stand components, measurement hardware, furnace systems, and power electronics interfaces

***Our requirements*****:**

* Currently enrolled in or pursuing a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Material Engineering, or a related technical discipline
* Previous research, laboratory, or industrial experience is beneficial but not required
* Knowledge of mechanical engineering, materials science, hydrogen technologies, electrochemistry, solid oxide systems, or related technical fields
* Ability to support electrochemical testing activities and experimental research projects
* Strong literature research, scientific writing, and technical documentation skills
* Ability to analyze, interpret, and present technical data in a structured manner
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications
* Familiarity with powder metal technologies and electrochemical testing methods is advantageous
* Strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently on technical assignments
* Effective teamwork and coordination skills when working with researchers, suppliers, and project stakeholders
* Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal
* Fluent German communication skills, both written and verbal

***Come join our global, inclusive \& diverse team***

  

Our purpose is to improve the quality of life of everyone we touch through our innovative motion systems. We are a truly global team bound together by our shared values. Our culture is built on the diversity, knowledge, skills, creativity, and talents that each employee brings to the company. Our people are our company’s most valuable asset. We are committed to providing an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace where employees of different backgrounds feel valued and respected, regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity or religious background. We are committed to inspiring our employees to grow, act with ownership and find fulfilment and meaning in the work they do.

title: WIG-Schweißer (m/w/d) - Rohrschweißer Anlagenbau (m/w/d)
jd:
Die Rock Solid Crew GmbH ist ein modernes Engineering\-Unternehmen mit Spezialisierung auf die Prozessindustrie. Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden von der ersten Idee über das Basic\- und Detail\-Engineering bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung anspruchsvoller Industrieprojekte. Dank unserer Hands\-on\-Mentalität, kurzen Entscheidungswege und hohen Fachkompetenz realisieren wir Projekte in den Bereichen Chemie, Petrochemie, Energie, Wasserstoff, Lebensmittelindustrie und Anlagenbau.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams am Standort **Buxtehude** suchen wir einen erfahrenen **WIG\-Schweißer / WIG\-Rohrschweißer (m/w/d)** für den Einsatz im industriellen **Anlagenbau**, **Rohrleitungsbau**, **Stahlbau** und in der **Prozessindustrie**.

**Ihre Aufgaben**

* Durchführung von WIG\-Schweißarbeiten nach DIN EN ISO 9606\-1
* Schweißen von Rohrleitungen, Rohrleitungskomponenten, Behältern und Anlagenkomponenten
* Verarbeitung von Werkstoffen der Werkstoffgruppen FM1, FM4 und FM5
* Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung von Schweißprozessen
* Herstellung hochwertiger und röntgensicherer Schweißnähte
* Qualitätskontrolle, Sichtprüfung und Dokumentation von Schweißarbeiten
* Lesen und Umsetzen technischer Zeichnungen, Isometrien und Fertigungsunterlagen
* Dokumentation von Schweißnähten und schweißtechnischen Prozessen
* Koordination kleiner Montageteams auf Baustellen oder im Werk
* Unterstützung bei Montagearbeiten im Rohrleitungs\- und Anlagenbau
* Sicherstellung von Arbeitssicherheit, Qualität und Ordnung im Arbeitsbereich
* Einhaltung von Normen, Richtlinien und Qualitätsanforderungen der Prozessindustrie

**Ihr Profil**

* Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Konstruktionsmechaniker (m/w/d), Metallbauer (m/w/d), Anlagenmechaniker (m/w/d), Industriemechaniker (m/w/d), Rohrleitungsbauer (m/w/d), Schweißer (m/w/d) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
* Erfahrung als WIG\-Schweißer, Rohrschweißer oder Schweißfacharbeiter im Anlagenbau
* Gültige WIG\-Schweißerprüfungen nach DIN EN ISO 9606\-1
* Nachweislich sichere Herstellung röntgensicherer Schweißnähte
* Erfahrung mit den Werkstoffgruppen FM1, FM4 und FM5
* Kenntnisse im Rohrleitungsbau, Industriebau, Anlagenbau oder Stahlbau
* Erfahrung im Lesen technischer Zeichnungen und Isometrien
* Idealerweise erste Erfahrung als Vorarbeiter, Teamleiter oder Schichtverantwortlicher
* Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
